jokes.hikaru_nakamura: Hikaru Nakamura is like a chess engine with a Twitch account: he calculates 30 moves ahead but still can’t find the line where he actually doesn’t care.
jokes.rfk_jr: RFK Jr. took the Kennedy legacy and somehow turned it into a YouTube comments section in a suit.
jokes.sherlock_holmes: Sherlock Holmes can identify 140 types of tobacco ash and solve a murder from a footprint—but still can’t deduce that “coked-up encyclopedia in a hat” isn’t a personality.
jokes.demis_hassabis: Demis Hassabis built AlphaGo, AlphaFold, and AlphaZero—because apparently the one thing his AI still can’t optimize is a name after “Alpha.”
jokes.steph_curry: Steph Curry changed basketball forever—now every guy at the YMCA thinks “terrible shot selection” is just faith with a jumpshot.
jokes.sam_altman: Sam Altman built ChatGPT to replace human judgment, which makes sense—his own board tried human judgment once and immediately needed a rollback.
jokes.lisa_manoban: Lisa Manoban’s dance moves are razor-sharp; her rap lyrics sound like a luxury mall directory fell down an escalator.
jokes.alex_honnold: Alex Honnold climbs without ropes because even his safety equipment has attachment issues around him.
jokes.jon_stewart: Jon Stewart is proof you don’t have to be tall to spend 25 years talking down to America from behind a desk.
jokes.dario_amodei: Dario Amodei built Claude to be harmless, helpful, and honest—which is impressive, because he personally only nailed the “harmless” part.
